julian_start: ^Julian Sallow: Relief watch, Agent. We've the duty desk for the night: the doors and the log.
julian_hub: ^What does the relief watch actually do?
^Is there anything the watch wants from me?

c-0: ^Julian Sallow: Operations are stood down. Somebody still has to mind the doors.
^Julian Sallow: The readers, the board, the log. Nothing glamorous, and nothing anyone will thank us for.
c-1: ^Julian Sallow: Carry your ID where it can be seen. Every classified system wants re-authentication tonight, so don't take it personally when a reader asks twice.
^Julian Sallow: Most people read a notice once, at the door. Tonight it's worth a second look.
c-2: ^Julian Sallow: Long enough to know a quiet floor isn't a calm one.
^Julian Sallow: Quiet is everyone listening for the door. Give me the printers, any night.
c-3: ^Julian Sallow: Go well. The log will note it, I'm afraid.

b: ^Agnieszka Duda: I've nothing to say to you.

agnieszka_start: ^Agnieszka Duda: Duda, watch log. If you need something entered, say it slowly. Tonight, every line gets read twice.

b: ^Agnieszka Duda: I've nothing to say to you.

agnieszka_hub: ^And if I see something that looks wrong?
^Do you ever get away from the desk?

c-0: ^Agnieszka Duda: Who came, who went, who asked for what. The Director reads it in the morning.
^Agnieszka Duda: I don't judge it. I write it down.
c-1: ^Agnieszka Duda: Tell the Director. Only the Director. Tell me and it's gossip with a timestamp.
^Agnieszka Duda: I would log that you told me, naturally. Which is why people tell me less than they might.
c-2: ^Agnieszka Duda: Water, when the log allows. Julian counts that as a break.
^Agnieszka Duda: I count it as a line in the log.
c-3: ^Agnieszka Duda: Mind the doors on your way out. They are logged too.

ex_relief_handover: ^Julian Sallow: The day watch left without a word.
^Agnieszka Duda: Nobody says much on Level Red.
^Julian Sallow: Then we write it down instead.
ex_lock_it: ^Agnieszka Duda: You left your console open again.
^Julian Sallow: Thirty seconds at the cooler.
^Agnieszka Duda: Long enough for a stranger to be you.
^Julian Sallow: All right. Lock it when I leave it.
ex_the_suite: ^Julian Sallow: They've taken someone down to the suite.
^Agnieszka Duda: No name goes in till the Director says.
